EnVue Telematics Wins Innovation Award at Geotab Connect

EnVue Telematics, a leading fleet technologies consulting company, received a Geotab Innovation Award in the Small Business Partner category at Geotab Connect in Orlando, Florida. The Innovation Awards, announced by Colin Sutherland, Geotab’s Chief Customer Officer, were given to nine partners for their innovative performance in various categories.
